# `src/generated/` — generated artifacts (do not edit)

Files here are produced from backend sources and committed so the frontend can
import them synchronously. **Do not edit them by hand** — regenerate instead.

| File | Generated by | Source of truth |
|------|--------------|-----------------|
| `snowflakeDataTypes.ts` | `go generate ./internal/snowflake/` (`scripts/gen_datatypes.go`) | `internal/snowflake/datatypes.go` (`snowflake.AllDataTypes`) |
| `objectKinds.ts` | `go generate ./internal/objectkind/` (`scripts/gen_object_kinds.go`) | `internal/objectkind/kinds.go` (`objectkind.Kinds`) |

The matching Go tests — `TestGeneratedDataTypesInSync` (in `internal/snowflake/`)
and `TestGeneratedObjectKindsInSync` (in `internal/objectkind/`) — fail if a
committed artifact drifts from its source, so regenerate after changing the
backend registry.

`objectKinds.ts` exports `OBJECT_KINDS` (name, label, `basic`, `ddl` per kind),
plus the `OBJECT_KIND_ORDER`, `OBJECT_KIND_LABEL` and `DDL_UNSUPPORTED_KINDS`
views over it. The sidebar tree grouping, the search type filter and every DDL
entry point read them, so adding an object kind is one Go registry entry — see
[`internal/objectkind/README.md`](../../../internal/objectkind/README.md). Icons
and colours stay hand-maintained in `components/sidebar/objectIcons.tsx`
(React components can't be generated), guarded by `objectIcons.test.ts`.
